stem: A square has an area of \(49\) square centimeters. What is the perimeter of the square, in centimeters?

explanation.A: Correct. Side \(= \sqrt{49} = 7\), so the perimeter is \(4 \cdot 7 = 28\).
explanation.B: Incorrect. This is \(2 \cdot 7\), the length of only two sides; a square has four sides.
explanation.C: Incorrect. This is the area, which was given; the question asks for the perimeter.
explanation.D: Incorrect. This is \(4 \cdot 49\), multiplying the area by 4 instead of the side length.

verify:
s=sqrt(49)
assert s==7
ans=4*s
assert ans==28
assert value(choices[answer])==ans
assert all(value(choices[k])!=ans for k in choices if k!=answer)
